description: Get details of one Sejm committee (komisja): name, type, scope of work, appointment date, members with their club and function (e.g. przewodniczący = chair), and codes of its subcommittees.

id.description: Code of the committee (komisja), e.g. ASW or FPB: the `code` field from get-committees

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-committee

code.description: Committee code, used by the other committee tools

function.description: Function in the body, e.g. przewodniczący (chair)

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Get a committee
